description: For appliance installation, this request form records connection requirements, code-listed parts, protection, leveling, anchoring, testing, haul-away, and customer orientation. use_case: Use the request form during residential appliance delivery and installation when the appliance installation record must identify appliance model, serial, location, dimensions, path, utilities, cabinetry, ventilation, and old-unit disposition. Complete the applicable handoff for installed condition, function verification, customer demonstration, warranty registration, debris removal, and signoff.
